items.description:
Fine Art Printers is a print and packaging business operating from Sunderland Ridge in Centurion, with roots going back to 1960. The company prints business cards, calendars, carbonless books, flyers, letterhead, notepads, posters, signage and vinyl stickers, and lets customers build an order online by choosing paper size, print colours, paper type, quantity and finishing to get real-time pricing. Customers can upload their own high-resolution artwork or have the team design it for an additional fee, and pay securely by credit card, instant EFT or Snapscan.

Finished orders are sent out by courier or can be collected from the factory in Sunderland Ridge, and the business keeps to set operating hours, Monday to Thursday from 7:30am to 4:30pm and Friday from 7:30am to 1:30pm, closed over weekends. That combination of decades in the trade, a wide print and signage range and a simple online ordering process makes it a practical option for businesses needing reliable, quick-turnaround printing.

Focus Ai Technologies is the in-house technology arm of the Focus Group, built after the group spent a decade frustrated by outside IT providers who left problems unresolved. Rather than switching providers again, Focus Group built its own internal IT function and software development team, drawing on more than twelve years of software engineering experience, and now offers that same capability to outside businesses. Its services cover managed IT support, cybersecurity and compliance, cloud solutions and custom automation and AI tools designed to remove manual, repetitive work from day-to-day operations.

Clients get one number to call for support, answered by a person who already knows their setup and stays with the problem until it is resolved, rather than being passed between call-centre agents. The team runs a baseline assessment scoring a business across eight areas of its IT before recommending a plan. Based in Clubview, Centurion, it suits small and mid-sized businesses that want dependable, accountable IT support without building their own internal team.

Foto First Elardus Park is a photographic printing and personalised-products shop trading from Elardus Park Centre. The shop handles photo printing and enlarging, canvas stretching, and canvas and banner printing, along with novelty printing onto mugs, t-shirts and jigsaw puzzles for gifts and keepsakes. It also offers a VHS-to-DVD conversion service for customers wanting to transfer old home-video tapes onto a more modern, lasting format.

Walk-in customers can bring memory cards, prints or old media directly to the Elardus Park store for processing, while the business also ships completed orders nationwide and takes payment through a secure online gateway for online orders. It is open Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 5:30pm, closed on weekends. The combination of traditional photo-shop services and personalised printing makes it a useful stop for anyone turning photos and memories into physical keepsakes.

Fumo is an Italian restaurant in Groenkloof Plaza known locally for its pizza and pasta, built around a classic, from-scratch Italian menu. The kitchen serves through the day, from breakfast through to dinner, and the restaurant pairs its food with a curated selection of wines and cocktails for guests who want to make a meal of it rather than grab a quick plate.

Based at Groenkloof Plaza on Bronkhorst Street in Groenkloof, Pretoria, Fumo offers dine-in seating as well as takeaway and delivery for guests who prefer to eat at home, and keeps to long daily hours, open every day from 11am to 9pm. That full-day availability and classic Italian focus make it a reliable choice for a casual lunch, a sit-down dinner or a pizza delivered to the door.

G4S Secure Solutions (SA) is the South African head office of G4S, a global security group, offering integrated security that spans manned guarding, electronic monitoring, cash-in-transit and cash management, access control and risk-based security planning, backed by technology-enabled services rather than guarding staff alone. As the national head office, the site also houses G4S's National Control Centre, the hub coordinating the company's monitoring and response operations across the country.

The head office trades from Byls Bridge Office Park in the Centurion area of Pretoria. Businesses and organisations across all nine South African provinces needing guarding, cash security, access control or broader integrated security planning can draw on this national head office and its control centre for coordinated, technology-backed support.

Gaulelo Events is an event-management and hire company based in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, offering turnkey planning for corporate functions, galas, conferences and weddings. The company handles the full brief for an event, from stage, sound and lighting to decor and furniture, and supplies marquee and flooring hire for functions that need a built structure rather than an existing venue.

Working across the Glen Lauriston area and the wider Centurion region, the team coordinates logistics and suppliers so that clients planning a gala dinner, a conference or a wedding celebration have one point of contact rather than several separate bookings. That turnkey approach, covering everything from flooring and marquees through to lighting and decor, suits businesses and families who want an event handled from planning through to the day itself without managing multiple vendors.

Gecko Printing & Finishing is a print and finishing business trading from Lyttelton Manor in Centurion, built out of years of experience in the printing trade. The business covers a wide range of printing and copying work, including business cards, booklets, stationery, pamphlets, flyers and posters, NCR books and notepads, plus signage and branding and a decor and finishing service that includes book binding and laminating.

The team positions itself on personal service and a quick turnaround, taking on jobs of any size from small personal print runs to larger signage and branding projects for local businesses. Working from its premises on the corner of Clifton and River Road in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, it serves customers who want printing handled start to finish by one supplier rather than split between a printer and a separate signage company.

Gendac is a custom software and electronics engineering firm based in Persequor Technopark, Pretoria, with 28 years in business. The company designs and builds custom software, mobile apps, systems integration and advanced embedded electronics shaped around how a client's organisation actually works, rather than off-the-shelf products the client has to adapt to. Its team has delivered more than 500 projects to date, ranging from operational systems and portals to field-ready mobile applications and connected devices that bridge physical equipment with digital systems.

With more than 90 people on staff, Gendac works across a range of industries, building technology that clients own outright and can keep developing on their own roadmap once delivered. Based in the Brummeria area of Pretoria, it suits organisations that need software or embedded electronics tailored to a specific operational problem rather than a generic package.

Gentron Group is a managed IT services provider based in Midstream Estate, Olifantsfontein, that has supplied hardware, software and IT outsourcing since 1992. Its day-to-day support covers proactive monitoring, fast problem-solving and system maintenance aimed at reducing downtime, alongside cloud storage and cloud email solutions that let teams access files and collaborate from anywhere. The company also runs a dedicated cybersecurity service, covering endpoint protection, email and phishing protection and ongoing security monitoring, plus networking and Wi-Fi installation and support.

On the hardware side, Gentron supplies and installs computers, laptops, servers, printers and business software for its clients. The business is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, closed over weekends. More than three decades in IT outsourcing give it a track record to draw on when advising businesses in and around Midstream Estate on modernising or securing their systems.

Gomelelo Environmental and Management Consulting is an environmental consultancy based in Philip Nel Park, Pretoria, named after the Tshivenda word for drought as a reminder of the consequences of environmental degradation. The practice carries out environmental feasibility studies and environmental impact assessments, prepares environmental management programmes and solid waste management plans, and handles environmental authorisation and water use licence applications on behalf of clients. Its services extend to land-use planning, GIS spatial mapping, hydrological assessments and public participation facilitation for projects that require community consultation.

Project developers across a range of industries use the practice to meet South Africa's environmental assessment requirements through every stage of a project's life cycle, from feasibility through to ongoing environmental auditing. Based in Philip Nel Park, Pretoria, the practice also offers technical report writing and training and development, making it a single point of contact for the environmental compliance side of a development project.

Gourmet Boutique Africa is a specialist importer and distributor of fine caviar, operating from Faerie Glen in Pretoria as part of a wider group with a presence across Asia, Africa, the United States and Japan. The business sources rare farmed sturgeon roe from verified producers in Iran's Caspian Sea region and from Chinese aquaculture operations, including Beluga, Kaluga and Acipenser varieties, with every harvest traceable back through its sourcing and certification system.

Its caviar is supplied to executive chefs, five-star hotels and resorts rather than sold as a general retail product, reflecting the business's focus on provenance and quality over volume. Based in Boardwalk Manor, Pretoria, Gourmet Boutique Africa suits hospitality operators and chefs looking for a dedicated, traceable caviar supply rather than a generic wholesale food source.

Graaff Brakes Centurion is the Zwartkop branch of the national Graaff Brakes workshop chain, specialising in brake disc and flywheel skimming, brake pad, shoe and drum supply, and mobile disc skimming for customers who can't bring a vehicle in. The branch also offers free brake checks, letting drivers get a professional opinion on wear before committing to a repair.

As one of more than twenty Graaff Brakes branches across South Africa, the Zwartkop workshop in Centurion draws on the group's buying power and brake-specific expertise rather than treating brakes as one of many general services. It is open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 5pm and Saturday mornings from 7:30am to midday, closed Sundays, giving drivers a dedicated specialist to turn to for disc, pad and drum work rather than a general mechanic.

Graphiprint SA designs, prints and installs custom signage from its premises in Olympus, Pretoria, covering shopfront and facade signage, reception branding and vehicle graphics for businesses wanting a consistent look across their premises and fleet. Alongside signage, the company produces promotional print and marketing materials, giving clients a single supplier for both large-format signage and smaller print runs.

Because the business handles design, printing and installation in-house, clients dealing with a shopfront refresh or a vehicle-branding project can work with one team from concept through to the finished, fitted result rather than coordinating separate designers, printers and installers. Based in Olympus, Pretoria, Graphiprint SA serves businesses across the city looking for signage and branded print produced and fitted by the same company.

GreenHouse - Solar Energy Solutions South Africa is a solar and battery-energy company founded in 2009 and based in Zwartkop, Centurion. The company designs, supplies and installs photovoltaic systems and battery storage for both residential and commercial clients, handling a project from system design through to installation rather than just supplying panels.

Trading for close to two decades in the local solar market, GreenHouse has built up experience sizing systems for different roof types, budgets and energy needs, from a single household installation to a larger commercial system. Based in Zwartkop in Centurion, the company serves homeowners and businesses across the greater Pretoria area who want a locally based installer to manage a solar and battery project from planning to switch-on.

Grobcon (Pty) Ltd is a construction company based in Zwartkop, Centurion, specialising in building fire damage, flood damage, subsidence and major structural damage repairs alongside general renovation work. Beyond major damage repair, the team also takes on plumbing, paving, roofing, flooring and solar panel installation, giving it a broad base of residential construction and renovation projects to draw on.

The business describes its approach as built on trust, honesty and transparency between contractor and client, aiming for a collaborative working relationship rather than a purely transactional one. Operating from Zwartkop in Centurion, Grobcon suits homeowners dealing with structural damage from fire, flood or subsidence as well as those planning a more general renovation, repair or solar installation project.

Group Afrique Consulting and Projects is a management consulting firm based in Garsfontein, Pretoria, offering strategy planning and facilitation, corporate training and project management services across the African continent. With more than twenty years in the field, the firm combines in-depth knowledge of local African markets with a broader international outlook, aiming to give clients solutions that account for the practical realities of doing business on the continent.

The firm takes a holistic view of consulting, building teams of professionals who bring different areas of expertise to a single engagement rather than relying on one generalist consultant. Values the company highlights include flexibility, innovation and a results-driven, participatory way of working with clients. Based in Woodhill Golf Estate in Pretoria, it suits organisations seeking strategic or project-management support shaped specifically for the African business environment.

GrubHouse Eco Park is a family-friendly diner in Eco-Park Estate, Centurion, part of the wider GRUBhouse retro-American diner chain known for its messy burgers and milkshakes. The Eco-Park branch serves wood-fired pizzas, burgers and milkshakes in an outdoor, nature-surrounded setting, giving it a different feel to a typical shopping-centre food court.

The venue is built around families, with a kids playroom and a VR playroom to keep younger visitors occupied while parents eat, and the brand positions itself as a place for first dates, midweek family dinners and birthday celebrations alike. Based in Eco-Park Estate, Centurion, GrubHouse Eco Park suits families and groups looking for a casual, child-friendly outdoor dining venue rather than a standard indoor restaurant.

HealthChem Pharmacy Midstream is a retail pharmacy trading from the Square @ Midstream shopping centre in Midstream Estate, offering prescription dispensing through an automated robotic system alongside a wide range of over-the-counter medication, wellness products and paediatric care items. The pharmacy runs an onsite clinic offering immunisations and Discovery Wellness Tests, and stocks dedicated ranges for infant feeding, nappies and maternity wellness as well as first aid and natural remedies.

For online orders, the pharmacy delivers free above R300 within Midstream Estate and ships nationwide, and also offers a Peleboxes locker collection service for customers who prefer to collect at a time that suits them. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 6pm, Saturday from 8am to 3pm and Sunday from 9am to 1pm. That combination of in-store clinic, dispensary and wellness retail makes it a convenient healthcare stop for residents of Midstream Estate and the surrounding area.

Hierarchy Management is a business consulting and marketing agency based in Monument Park, established in 2014. Its consulting side focuses on bid, proposal and tender compilation along with project administration and compliance support for businesses pursuing public and corporate procurement opportunities. On the marketing side, the agency builds and runs social media campaigns, Google Ads and YouTube advertising, along with web design and branding work for clients wanting a consistent look across their online presence.

The agency also curates events and books talent for brands looking to create an immersive, results-driven activation rather than a standard function. Based in Monument Park, Pretoria, Hierarchy Management suits businesses that need help navigating government and corporate tender processes as well as those wanting an ongoing marketing partner for digital advertising and content.

Highveld Autoworks is a vehicle repair and maintenance workshop based in Highveld Techno Park, Centurion, staffed by a small team of mechanics, service advisors and technicians. The workshop covers diagnostics, brakes, suspension and clutch work, plus air conditioner repairs, belt and hose replacement, radiator repairs and engine repair and rebuilds, alongside routine oil changes, filters, tyres and both minor and major services.

The team's stated aim is building long-term trust with customers through reliable, affordable repairs rather than one-off transactions, and the workshop positions itself as a destination for ongoing vehicle care rather than a single repair. Based in Highveld Techno Park, Centurion, Highveld Autoworks suits drivers looking for a local, full-service mechanic that can handle both everyday servicing and more specialised mechanical repairs.

Hillview High School is a public, English-medium co-educational high school in Roseville, Pretoria, catering for grades 8 to 12. The school was founded in 1955 and has operated from its Roseville campus since 1979, giving it close to five decades of history at its current site. It currently has an enrolment of around 1,500 pupils.

As a public secondary school, Hillview follows the standard South African admissions process set out under the Schools Act, with registration for new intakes typically opening the year before enrolment. Based in Roseville, Pretoria, the school serves families in the surrounding suburbs looking for an established, longer-running public high school for their children's secondary education.

HMA South Africa (Wear) is the local arm of the HMA Group's wear-solutions range, supplying wear-resistant products to the mining, materials-handling and processing industries from its base in Derdepoort Smallholdings, Pretoria. Its product range includes ceramic and polyurethane-lined pipe and piping systems, cyclones and impact panels, along with abrasion- and corrosion-resistant compounds built to withstand the wear that comes with moving bulk materials.

HMA Group has been manufacturing, distributing and servicing capital plant equipment since 1966, with operations spanning Australia, New Zealand, Indonesia and South Africa across mining, materials handling, water management, power generation and oil and gas. Based in Derdepoort Smallholdings, the South African wear-solutions division draws on that international engineering background to supply equipment built to handle abrasive and corrosive conditions on local sites.

items.reason: A deeper pass found two different addresses in play: Woodlands Boulevard Shopping Centre (corner Garsfontein Road & De Villebois Mareuil Drive) confirms @Home as a tenant, matching this business's name, but a separate current listing instead gives a Woodlake Drive, Woodhill Golf Estate address, matching this file's own suburb/address field. These read as two different locations, and it's unclear which is the actual branch behind this listing; still only chain-level facts either way, so this stays deferred until the address is resolved.

items.description:
HVL IT Services is a Centurion-based IT company offering computer hardware and software sales, installation and support, including desktops, laptops, servers and printers alongside Microsoft 365, Azure and Adobe Creative Cloud setup and support. The business also handles Microsoft Dynamics 365 and server support, covering installation, configuration and ongoing troubleshooting for business clients.

Alongside its IT work, HVL IT Services offers graphic design services such as logo design, business card and letterhead design, and web design and hosting, giving clients a single supplier for both their computer systems and their branded materials. It also caters to hobbyist customers through Cricut cutting machines, tools and accessories. Based in Celtisdal, Centurion, the business suits small and medium companies wanting IT support and basic design services from one local provider.

I-CAT International Consulting and Trading is an environmental management and products company based in The Willows, Pretoria, operating across fire suppression, dust suppression and planting technology. Its Fire Division supplies certified fire suppression and detection systems for conveyors, vehicles, transformers and other high-risk industrial equipment, while its dust-suppression range offers eco-friendly dust control and misting systems designed to reduce water use and improve haul-road safety on mines and industrial sites.

As an original equipment manufacturer, I-CAT develops its own specialised technology for dust and fire suppression rather than reselling imported systems, and carries out multi-disciplinary research and development to keep its products cost-effective and sustainable. The company's planting-solutions division also supplies rootzone-targeted planting technology for the agriculture, horticulture and forestry sectors. Based in The Willows, Pretoria, I-CAT serves mining, industrial and agricultural clients across South Africa.

IBC SOLAR South Africa is a solar energy distributor based in Rooihuiskraal North, Centurion, supplying premium photovoltaic and storage systems and technical services to residential installers and the commercial and industrial EPC market. Distributing since 1982, the company's product range runs from solar panels, inverters and batteries through to mounting systems, EV chargers and monitoring equipment, sourced from established global brands including LONGi, GoodWe and Fronius.

IBC SOLAR also runs a premium partner programme for installers, giving them access to planning tools, technical training, certification programmes and marketing support alongside the product range itself. Based in Rooihuiskraal North, Centurion, the company serves installers and EPC contractors across the region rather than selling directly to individual homeowners, positioning itself as a supply and technical-support partner for the local solar trade.

ICS - Illungile Consulting Services is a multidisciplinary consulting firm based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, established in 2011. The practice works across development and project management, quantity surveying and shopping-centre leasing, giving clients a single firm to manage both the build side of a project and its ongoing commercial leasing.

Over its time in operation, the firm has worked on more than 700,000 square metres of mixed-use developments across South Africa, building experience in projects that combine retail, commercial and residential space under one roof. Based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, ICS suits property developers and shopping-centre owners who need quantity surveying, project management and leasing expertise handled by one consulting team rather than several separate specialists.

ICTGlobe is a Tier 1 telecommunications and IT solutions provider based in Highveld, Centurion, offering voice and communication services including VoIP, IP PBX and Cloud PBX systems. The company owns and operates its own network rather than reselling someone else's infrastructure, which it says gives it more control over call quality and pricing, and it also supplies fibre and wireless connectivity, including reseller packages for Frogfoot FTTH links.

Beyond connectivity, ICTGlobe runs cloud hosting from its own Tier 3 data centre and offers a reseller programme that gives partner businesses access to its voice, connectivity and cloud products under their own brand. Based in Highveld Techno Park, Centurion, the company serves both end-user businesses needing reliable voice and internet services and resellers looking to build a telecoms offering on ICTGlobe's network.

IEDM Digital Marketing is a digital marketing agency based in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, founded in 2000 and recognised as an official Google Premier Partner. The agency runs Google Ads and social media advertising campaigns, email marketing and search engine optimisation work for its clients, and provides monthly performance reporting so businesses can see how campaigns are performing over time.

More than two decades in the digital marketing industry give the agency a long track record compared to many newer, smaller agencies in the same space, and its Google Premier Partner status reflects a level of platform expertise that Google formally recognises. The agency is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm. Based in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, IEDM suits businesses looking for an established, locally based digital marketing partner rather than a large national or international agency.

iMarttrends Marketing Pretoria is a web and mobile app development agency serving small and medium businesses across Bryntirion and the wider Pretoria area. The agency builds professional websites, sales funnels and landing pages aimed at generating enquiries, along with custom mobile applications designed to improve customer engagement for its clients.

Its online marketing services cover search engine optimisation, social media marketing, email marketing and Google Ads management, and the agency has worked with businesses in sectors including education, skills training and financial services. Based in Bryntirion, Pretoria, iMarttrends positions itself as a plan-build-launch partner for small businesses that need a website or app built properly without in-house technical staff, agreeing project scope upfront before development begins.

Infinite Process Solutions is a systems-integration and controls-engineering firm based at Highveld Techno Park in Centurion, specialising in batch, discrete and process automation. The company delivers turnkey electrical, software and mechanical engineering solutions built around PLC and SCADA/HMI technology, integrating IT systems with plant-floor control systems and manufacturing execution systems for industrial clients.

Its project work has included an Allen Bradley RSLogix to Siemens PCS 7 control-system migration for a major platinum mine, and energy control-system upgrades and DCS communications work for oil and energy sites. Beyond integration work, the firm also offers contract staffing of automation engineers and data engineering, machine learning and predictive analytics services. Based in Highveld, Centurion, it serves mining, energy and industrial clients needing both hands-on automation engineering and ongoing technical staffing support.

items.reason: A deeper pass found professional records connecting Innova3D to SolidWorks mechanical-design work (3D parametric/feature-based design, assemblies, technical drawings, MBD, PDM) dating to 2016, consistent with the existing description, but could not independently confirm the Southdowns Ridge Office Park address is still current or find a current official website or any citable source URL. Stays deferred pending address/status verification.

items.description:
Intenda Financial Services is a financial technology firm based in Doringkloof, Centurion, established in 2013 as part of the Intenda group. The company has built a policy administration system used within the short-term insurance industry, giving insurers and intermediaries software to manage policies through their lifecycle rather than relying on manual processing.

Alongside its software side, Intenda Financial Services operates as an underwriting agency for motorbike insurance, combining technology development with hands-on underwriting experience in a specific insurance niche. Based in Doringkloof, Centurion, the business serves insurers, intermediaries and motorbike owners looking for insurance administration and underwriting handled by a specialist rather than a broad, generalist provider.

InXpress Pretoria is the local franchise of the global InXpress courier and freight network, based in the Boardwalk Manor area of Pretoria. The franchise helps small and medium businesses access pre-negotiated shipping rates and an easy-to-use transport management system for parcel and freight bookings, backed by a global network spanning 14 countries, more than 450 franchises and over 46,000 business shipping customers.

While connected to that international network for rates and systems, each InXpress location, including the Pretoria franchise, is independently owned and run, giving customers the personal attention of dealing directly with a local business owner rather than a call centre. Based in Boardwalk Manor, Pretoria, InXpress Pretoria suits small and medium businesses that ship regularly and want dedicated local support alongside competitive courier and freight rates.

iNyathi Knives is a knife-making workshop based in Florauna, Pretoria North, that has hand-crafted knives since 2008. The maker trained with members of the Knife-makers Guild of Southern Africa before starting the business, and produces tactical, hunting, kitchen and folding knives using Damascus, carbon and stainless steels such as 12C27, finished with natural-material handles and matching leather sheaths.

The name iNyathi is the Swahili word for buffalo, reflecting a personal connection to the animal, and each knife carries a maker's mark combining a surname with a buffalo head. Drawing on a background as an outdoorsman and competitive shooter, the maker designs knives meant for practical, everyday use rather than purely as display pieces. Based in Florauna, Pretoria North, iNyathi Knives suits hunters, outdoorsmen and collectors looking for a locally handmade, working knife.

IP Dimension is an IT managed service provider based in Centurion, founded in 1997, offering outsourced IT support on a flexible month-to-month subscription rather than long-term lock-in contracts. Its service includes certified technicians handling day-to-day IT issues, proactive monitoring to catch problems before they disrupt a business, and cloud services including Microsoft 365, AWS workloads and secure backup and recovery.

On the security side, the company runs endpoint and breach-prevention tools for Microsoft 365 environments, and also offers IT asset finance so clients can spread the cost of hardware and equipment. The business holds a POPIA compliance certificate and a current B-BBEE certificate. Based in Highveld Techno Park, Centurion, IP Dimension suits businesses that have outgrown ad-hoc IT support and want a scalable, contract-free outsourced IT department.

Italpac is a plastic packaging manufacturer based in Rosslyn, Akasia, with more than 30 years of experience in the industry. The company is FSSC 22000 accredited and ISO certified, and produces both stock and custom-printed plastic bags for the food, agricultural, mining and pharmaceutical sectors, including butcher bags, produce bags such as carrot, apple and pear, and gem squash bags, bread and cake bags, and recycled trolley bin liners.

Italpac positions itself as one of the leading plastic packaging manufacturers in South Africa, continuing to develop new products and cost-saving solutions for its customers across these sectors. The company also supports the Hennops Revival Project as a community partner, sponsoring the refuse bags used in river clean-up work around the Hennops River. Based in Rosslyn, Akasia, Italpac supplies packaging to businesses across the food, agricultural and industrial supply chain.

JacaWiFi is a wireless internet service provider based in Mayville, Pretoria, that erects its own independent masts to deliver uncapped wireless internet to customers without requiring a fixed telephone line. By building its own wireless infrastructure rather than relying solely on existing telecoms lines, the provider can reach customers in areas where a traditional fixed line isn't practical or available.

Alongside its wireless internet packages, JacaWiFi also offers fibre connections and network installation work for homes and small businesses needing a wired alternative or a combined setup. Based in Mayville, Pretoria, the provider serves residential and small business customers across the surrounding area looking for an uncapped internet connection with a locally managed wireless network behind it.

Jaco Truter Real Estate is an estate agency based in Villieria, Pretoria, handling residential property sales and rentals in the area. The agency maintains an active portfolio spanning houses, apartments, townhouses and commercial properties across Pretoria, with listings regularly updated as new stock comes onto the market in suburbs such as Rietondale, Moregloed, Waverley and Villieria itself.

Clients can search current listings, book a free property evaluation if they are looking to sell, and set up email alerts for new properties matching their criteria. Based in Villieria, Pretoria, the agency suits buyers and sellers looking for a locally focused estate agent working across Pretoria's northern and eastern suburbs rather than a large national franchise.

Jeocom Internet Provider is an internet service provider based in Eersterust, Pretoria, offering OpenServe fibre-to-the-home connections alongside MTN Fixed LTE wireless broadband for customers who need high-speed internet without a fibre line. The company also supplies and installs VoIP phones, wired and Wi-Fi home and office networks, and web and email hosting with domain registration.

Beyond connectivity, Jeocom sells and repairs laptops and desktop computers, and offers printing, faxing and scanning services alongside internet security software such as Kaspersky. Based in Eersterust, Pretoria, the business serves residential and small business customers looking for a single local provider for internet connectivity, basic computer hardware and everyday office support services.

Just Sell Properties is an owner-managed real estate agency with a branch in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, bringing more than 20 years of experience to residential and commercial property sales and rentals across Pretoria and Centurion. The agency has grown to three or more branches and more than 30 agents, while still operating on the same personal, client-focused principles it started with.

The agency positions itself around a straightforward promise: its agents work to sell and let properties for their clients' benefit, not simply to suit their own convenience. Its offering includes property search tools, area profiles, calculators and email alerts for new listings. Based in Magalieskruin, the Just Sell Properties branch suits buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants across Pretoria and Centurion looking for a locally rooted agency with a multi-branch reach.

Kakebeen is a handcrafted goods workshop based in Les Marais, Pretoria, producing items from reclaimed materials and premium woods using CNC routing and engraving, 3D printing, silicone mould making and t-shirt printing. Its product range spans desk organisers, jewellery and gift boxes, plant pots and custom corporate gifts, built for both individuals wanting something unique and businesses wanting branded items to hand out to clients.

The workshop takes on everything from one-off custom jobs to small production runs, offering design and personalisation alongside manufacturing so a customer can turn an idea into a finished object rather than just ordering off a catalogue. Based in Les Marais, Pretoria, Kakebeen suits businesses looking for branded corporate gifts and individuals wanting a personalised, locally made gift or keepsake.

KBK Engineers is a civil and structural engineering consultancy established in 1968 and based in Faerie Glen, Pretoria. The firm is a Level 1 B-BBEE contributor and ISO 9001:2015 certified, providing consulting services across roads, structures, bulk water and sanitation, infrastructure development, stormwater management and project management for both public and private sector clients.

Its project team includes professionally registered engineers, technologists, technicians and project and construction managers, each working within a specific design specialisation, and the firm has taken on projects of a scale often reserved for larger consultancies. KBK makes use of industry software including Civil 3D, AutoCAD and RoadMaker for its design and modelling work. Based at Glenwood Office Park in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, the firm serves government bodies and private developers needing established civil and structural engineering expertise.

Ketelkraal is a distillery and brewery based in Hennopspark, Centurion, running its own taproom and walk-in liquor store alongside a contract and white-label distilling service for other brands. The business also supplies kegs for on-tap dispensing at events, giving function and venue organisers a draught option beyond bottled products.

Beyond production, Ketelkraal carries out lab testing of distilled products, a service that points to technical capability beyond simply bottling spirits for its own label. Based in Hennopspark, Centurion, the business suits both everyday customers visiting the taproom or liquor store and other drinks brands looking for a local contract distilling and white-label production partner.

Keystone Human Capital provides customised HR, labour relations and training solutions to smaller South African companies from its base in Murrayfield, Pretoria. The practice focuses specifically on the challenges smaller businesses face around managing staff, helping owners put in place easy-to-use systems for labour relations support, HR frameworks, training and recruitment.

Each client is assigned a dedicated team to handle their recruitment, industrial relations and training needs, rather than being passed between different consultants for each service. The underlying aim is to free up time and budget for smaller companies so they can focus on growing the business while the people side is managed for them. Based in Murrayfield, Pretoria, the practice suits small and medium businesses that don't have the scale to run an in-house HR department.

KFC Helen Joseph Street trades as KFC Centre Place, operating from the Centre Place Building on Helen Joseph Street, formerly Church Street, in the heart of the Pretoria CBD. Like other KFC branches, it serves fried chicken, chicken buckets, burgers, wraps, sides and combination meals for dine-in or takeaway, but this branch carries its own halal certification, certificate number H786/NR130, valid through February 2027, a credential that applies to this specific outlet rather than the chain nationally.

Operating from a CBD building named for the branch itself rather than a generic street address alone, KFC Centre Place serves office workers, students and shoppers moving through central Pretoria who want a quick, halal-certified chicken meal without detouring from the CBD's main commercial strip.

KLD Attorneys is a law firm based in Irene, Centurion, offering legal services across commercial law, construction law, family law, labour law and compliance-related matters. Rather than specialising narrowly in one area, the firm positions itself around tailoring its advice to each client's particular circumstances, aiming for transparent, straightforward communication rather than the more formal approach associated with some traditional firms.

Operating from Southdowns Ridge Office Park on the corner of John Vorster and Nellmapius Drives in Irene, the firm serves individuals and businesses across Centurion and the wider Pretoria area needing advice or representation spanning commercial, construction, family, labour or regulatory compliance matters.

KVV Inc is a boutique property law and conveyancing firm with a branch in Die Hoewes, Centurion, marking ten years in operation. The firm handles property transfers, bond registration and cancellation, and subdivision and sectional title registration, work that sits specifically within property law rather than general legal practice.

Beyond its Centurion office, KVV Inc operates branches across Gauteng and the Western Cape, including Pretoria, Krugersdorp, Bedfordview, Randburg and Cape Town, giving it reach across multiple property markets under one firm. Based at Die Hoewes in Centurion, the firm suits buyers, sellers and property developers who need dedicated conveyancing and property-transaction legal support rather than a general-practice attorney.

La Coco C Food Purveyors is a bakery, cafe and health food store trading from the Shere Lifestyle Centre in Shere, Pretoria East, with more than 11 years in hospitality behind it. The kitchen serves homemade dishes and fresh juices made from fresh, locally sourced ingredients, alongside grab-and-go options for customers who want something quick rather than sitting down for a full meal.

Among its menu, the C Steak Sandwich has become a regular lunch favourite, alongside sweeter options such as its vegan brownie. The store is open Monday to Friday from 7am to 5pm and Saturdays and public holidays from 7am to 2pm, closed on Sundays. Based in Shere Lifestyle Centre, it suits customers in Shere and the wider Pretoria East area looking for a casual, health-conscious cafe rather than a conventional takeaway.

La Montagne Primary School is a fee-charging public primary school in La Montagne, Pretoria, covering Grade R to Grade 7 within the Tshwane South education district. As a Quintile 5 school, it sets its own tuition fees because government funding alone, capped at a set amount per learner under the Department of Education's quintile system, doesn't cover the school's full costs.

Admission follows the standard process set out under the South African Schools Act, with registration for the following year's intake typically opening between April and October and specific age requirements for Grade R and Grade 1 entry. The school currently has an enrolment of around 884 learners taught by about 31 educators. Based in La Montagne, Pretoria, it serves families in the surrounding suburb looking for an established, fee-paying public primary school.
